transcript: Haan Hello Hello, Abhishek se baat ho rahi hai. Theek hai. Arvind ji se baat ho rahi hai. Haan ji Sir main Prerna baat kar rahi hoon, Hari Om Traders, aapki business profile IP Janaka. Achha Haan ji, main ismein dekh paa rahi thi aap yeh rake feet leather yeh product mein deal karta hai right sir? Ji Haan ji, toh yeh jo aapne tiles apna update kar rakha hai, jaise artificial leather hai, do sau rupaye meter aapke dikh rakha hai, hai na? Abhi depend karta hai kaun sa hai wala, sab sab alag alag price pe hote hain. Ji toh wahi cheez aapki na profile pe na ye cheez updated bhi hai, like mere ko na ye cheez update karwani hai taki zyada se zyada inquiries aa sake aapke paas direct inquiries hai na? Hmm hmm, aapke near by ke hi fifty six log hain. Kooda Jivein product ki requirement hai leather ya exclusive ki hai na Yeh kaun sa website hai sir? Sahi hai India barta hai aapka. Hello Haan ji Haan haan Toh sir aap India Works pe active hain Sunal mein? India madhyam mein toh main. India Mart mein toh mera aa hi raha hai. Haan, matlab application use karte hain aap India Mart ki? Haan, application toh use karte hain, usmein se vo bhi raha hai, calls bhi aate hain, sab kuch aate hain, inquiries aa jaate hain. Haan Haan taaki vo inquiries aur zyada hai na isliye vo aapki profile update karani hai hai na already dekho aapke product ki photos dali hui hai par ismein kya hai specification add ho jayegi na toh koi bhi agar yeh product search karega toh na aapki profile visible ho jayegi sir hai na Haan, vo toh Google se bhi ho hi jaata hai abhi filhaal toh. Sir humne package mein rakha hai Indiabad ka. Package nahi hai, jab bhi naya naya launch hota tab bhi se mera start aayi diya Mahatma se. Haan, as a free seller registered hai abhi toh aap India baad se. Toh sir main ek business executive ki meeting schedule kara deti hoon taki woh aapke yahan ke aapki profile update kar de, hai na? Mere ko ek bada apni information bhi batana, matlab apna address confirm karna, shop number ninety five, Shravan number fourteen, Thakkar Bappa Colony, yahi hai na sir? Hoon Hum Ji ji location aapki hai ji Theek hai aur business owner aapki hai sir Yet partnership aapke irukke. Nahi nahi, vo toh hamara unse baat ho gaya tha, main bola abhi jab bhi aisa kuchh rahega toh hum log karwa lenge, abhi as of abhi aisa kuchh update karne ka toh socha nahi hai. As of me aisa kuch Update karne ka toh socha nahi hai. Yeh already humare. Ye jo already hamare paas inquiry aa hi rahe. Ji matlab India Mart se hi mere ko aa raha hai. IndiaMart se hi mere ko aa raha hai, IndiaMart ho gaya, Justdial ho gaya, Google pe aa jata hai. Haan Abhi online business kar rahe hain kisi bhi platform pe jahan matlab aap paid services le rakhe ho aapne. Nahi nahi, aisa kuch nahi hai. Okay, like abhi dekho aapke queries aa rahi hai, theek hai? Usko aur zyada update karenge kyonki dekho aapke aas paas ke jaise Shri Ganesh Kripa Leather hai, aapki Home Textile LLP hai, Varun Text hai, and sometimes profile update kara rakhi hai, toh inko direct queries ka bhi flow chha jata hai. Hum hum Iske liye aapko kuchh pray nahi karna hota hai, like woh aayenge aapki profile ek baar update karke chale jayenge. Mere ko aapki profile update karani hai taki dekho aapke paas business aayega, toh in future aap kabhi na kabhi toh apna paid services lenge, India Bank se achha business milega agar aapko hai na? Aaya toh phir abhi beech mein ek do baar aake gaye. Ji vo toh sir November mein gaye the uske baad dekho aapke product ke bhi price change hue honge hai na? 15 hi November mein change kar rahe hain ji aur usmein kuch product naye bhi aaye honge aapke naye design bhi aaye honge ya naye kapda bhi aaya hoga toh us cheez ke liye profile update kara rahi hoon hai na? Pandaraayiram. Sir aap mujhe kal ka ek time bata dijiye ya phir aaj shaab ka chaar baje ka ek time bata dijiye chaar baje ke aas paas main ek meeting schedule kara di aapki. Abhi toh main pahunchunga abhi ab baaki main toh bhai call kiye dekhta hoon kaisa kya hai. Toh kal karte hain sir, aaj shahar baje pe kal gyarah baje ya baarah baje hai na? Mere ko call kar dena hai. Call kar dena haan ji, aadhe se pehle ek baar aapko call kar lenge, kal gyarah baje ki birthday ko fix kara deti hoon lagta hai, hai na? Okay sir, thank you.
